# Muffin public documentation

> Status: developer preview, pre-DAY-1. Current product claims are intentionally
> narrower than the vision. Numbered Italian chapters are historical H1 2026
> material and must not be presented as the current runtime.

## Current sources

- README.md — public overview and maturity labels
- docs/VISION.md — product destination, explicitly ahead of runtime
- docs/CURRENT.md — current public capability and non-capability claims
- docs/ARCHITECTURE.md — current public architecture boundaries
- docs/INSTALL.md — authorised developer-preview installation and use
- docs/ROADMAP.md — product phases without release dates
- docs/SECURITY.md — current public security and privacy boundaries
- docs/FAQ.md — common distinctions and status questions

## Historical sources

- HISTORY.md — index and interpretation rule for the H1 2026 corpus
- 01-filosofia.md through 08-faq.md — historical, not current
